scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on his account and requesting a refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Diego Martinez and I'm 66. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Okay, I see. Can you tell me your full name and age again so I can pull up the account?
I just said it, but sure. Diego Martinez, 66.
Thanks. I'm looking at the transaction here for $76. It says it's from 'Global Tech Services'. Does that ring a bell?
No, I've never heard of that company. I don't do business with them.

Look, I can't really tell you much more about it. Our policy says I can't see the specific merchant details beyond what you see on your statement. I'm just going to send this over to our fraud department since you don't recognize it.
Wait, so you can't help me right now? Can you at least see where the charge originated from?
I already told you, I don't have access to that. I'm escalating this to the fraud team now. They will contact you in 3-5 business days.

escalation_reason: Agent failed to perform basic verification or look up transaction details, citing a lack of access to justify immediate escalation of a standard dispute.
